q01.reference_answer: The Transformer uses attention without recurrence or convolutions, enabling more parallelizable sequence modeling.

expected_evidence.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

q01.label_provenance: Assistant-reviewed against stored paper text; human review recommended.

q02.reference_answer: Compute query-key dot products, scale by the square root of key dimension, apply softmax, and use those weights on the values.

expected_evidence.quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by √dk, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.

q02.label_provenance: Assistant-reviewed against stored paper text; human review recommended.

q03.reference_answer: Positional encodings supply token-order information absent from recurrence or convolution.

expected_evidence.quote: Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.

q03.label_provenance: Assistant-reviewed against stored paper text; human review recommended.

q04.reference_answer: Multi-head attention applies attention in parallel to learned projections of queries, keys and values, then concatenates and projects the outputs.

expected_evidence.quote: On each of these projected versions of queries, keys and values we then perform the attention function in parallel, yielding dv-dimensional output values. These are concatenated and once again projected, resulting in the final values, as depicted in Figure 2.

q04.label_provenance: Assistant-reviewed against stored paper text; human review recommended.

q05.reference_answer: BERT pretrains with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction.

expected_evidence.quote: Inaddition to the masked language model, we also use a 'next sentence prediction' task that jointly pretrains text-pair representations.
